messages.subject: Multilevel SEM with Mod-Med in R -- livestream seminar (last chance!)
parts:
Hi everyone
Last chance to sign up for the upcoming Multilevel SEM with Moderated Mediation in R seminar sponsored by Instats, which is a 2-day seminar introducing the lavaan multilevel latent variable modeling framework. The seminar describes multilevel variance and effect decomposition, and then proceeds with multilevel path analysis, multilevel CFA, and multilevel SEM, including approaches for handling strong correlations at the between-group level, indirect effects (multilevel mediation), within-group interaction effects (multilevel moderation), bootstrapping, and instrumental variable methods for identifying multilevel causal effects. Not everyone seems to know that lavaan is able to estimate these types of models, particularly within-group moderated mediation, but this is possible both in multilevel path models or with latent variable interactions in MCFA!

https://instats.com/workshop_info/1651738327238x101424288793886720

An official Instats certificate of completion is provided at the conclusion of the seminar, and like all live Instats seminars, the seminar webpage has its own forum with 30 days of Q&A support and will include recordings of all livestreamed sessions so that you can participate asynchronously if you prefer.

As always, Instats offers discounts for PhD students and weekly Office Hours that provide free stats help for anyone who is interested! You can find all of Instats's offerings here (instats.com/workshops), including additional structured programs and upcoming office hours by clicking their respective tab. 

Hope to see you soon!


Michael Zyphur
Director
